name: Savitribai Phule
known: Opened India's first school for girls in Pune in 1848, with her husband Jyotirao, at a time when educating girls was actively opposed. Taught through social boycott and abuse.

name: Dr. Anandi Gopal Joshi
known: One of the first Indian women to earn a degree in Western medicine, graduating in the United States in 1886 at the age of 21.

name: Kalpana Chawla
known: From Karnal, Haryana, she became the first woman of Indian origin to fly in space, flying aboard the Space Shuttle Columbia in 1997.

name: Dr. Tessy Thomas
known: Aerospace scientist at DRDO, project director for the Agni-IV and Agni-V missile programmes, the first woman to lead a missile project in India.

name: Mary Kom
known: Six-time World Amateur Boxing champion from Manipur, Olympic bronze medallist in 2012, and the only woman boxer to win a medal in each of the first seven World Championships.

name: P. T. Usha
known: Sprinter from Kerala who missed an Olympic medal by 1/100th of a second in 1984, won numerous Asian Games medals, and later ran an athletics academy for young women.

name: Arunima Sinha
known: Lost a leg after being thrown from a moving train in 2011. In 2013 she became the first woman amputee to climb Mount Everest, and has since climbed the highest peak on every continent.

name: Chhavi Rajawat
known: Left a corporate career to become sarpanch of Soda village in Rajasthan, working on water, sanitation, solar power and roads.

name: Kiran Bedi
known: The first woman to join the Indian Police Service, in 1972. Known for prison reform work at Tihar Jail.

name: Justice Fathima Beevi
known: The first woman appointed a judge of the Supreme Court of India, in 1989.

name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy
known: The first woman legislator in British India, a surgeon, and the founder of the Adyar Cancer Institute. Campaigned against child marriage.

name: Rani Lakshmibai
known: Queen of Jhansi, who led her forces in the 1857 rebellion and became a lasting symbol of resistance.

name: Begum Rokeya
known: Writer and educator who founded a school for Muslim girls in Kolkata in 1911 and argued for women's education and economic independence.

name: Amrita Pritam
known: Poet and novelist in Punjabi and Hindi, the first woman to receive the Sahitya Akademi Award, in 1956.

name: M. S. Subbulakshmi
known: Carnatic vocalist, the first musician to receive the Bharat Ratna, and the first Indian to perform at the United Nations General Assembly.

name: Indira Gandhi
known: The first and so far only woman Prime Minister of India, serving from 1966 to 1977 and again from 1980 to 1984.

name: Ritu Karidhal
known: ISRO scientist, deputy operations director for the Mars Orbiter Mission and mission director for Chandrayaan-3.

name: Harshini Kanhekar
known: India's first woman firefighter, graduating from the National Fire Service College in Nagpur in 2002.

name: Jhulan Goswami
known: Fast bowler from a small town in West Bengal, the leading wicket-taker in women's one-day international cricket.

name: Bachendri Pal
known: The first Indian woman to reach the summit of Mount Everest, in 1984.

name: Smriti Mandhana
known: Opening batter for India, among the leading run-scorers in women's international cricket.
